**Bottom line**  
The paper with PMID 39369609 compares sotorasib versus docetaxel in pretreated KRAS G12C-mutated advanced NSCLC using a real-world observational design. A correction (erratum PMID 39984314) was retrieved but its text was not available, so no corrected content was applied. The 2L and 2L+ cohorts show longer median overall survival for sotorasib than for docetaxel, with mortality HRs favoring sotorasib.  

**Confidence:** moderate (computed from claim support) for the extracted numeric results (directly quoted from the abstract); moderate for the study title (not supplied in the evidence).

### 1. Title, disease population, study design  
- **Title:** *Not provided in the evidence* (the abstract begins with the objectives statement; no title field appears).  
- **Disease population:** Pretreated KRAS G12C-mutated advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).  
- **Study design:** Observational real-world study using a US-based electronic health record-derived de-identified database; patients were propensity-score weighted (overlap weighting) to balance sotorasib and docetaxel cohorts.  

### 2. Correction status  
- A correction (erratum) exists for PMID 39369609 (linked erratum PMID 39984314).  
- The correction notice was retrieved (see `<literature_limitations>`).  
- The retrieved correction notice contains no abstract or text, so corrected content was **not applied** to the extracted data.  

### 3. Second-line (2L) and second-line-or-later (2L+) outcomes  

| Setting | Treatment arm | N (patients) | Median OS (95 % CI) | Mortality HR (95 % CI) vs. comparator |
|---------|---------------|--------------|---------------------|----------------------------------------|
| 2L      | Sotorasib     | 102          | 10.2 months (7.6-16.3) | 0.62 (0.41-0.93) |
| 2L      | Docetaxel     | 58           | 6.0 months (4.2-11.0)  | 0.62 (0.41-0.93) |
| 2L+     | Sotorasib     | 164          | 10.2 months (8.0-14.6) | 0.65 (0.49-0.87) |
| 2L+     | Docetaxel     | 116          | 7.2 months (5.1-10.6)  | 0.65 (0.49-0.87) |
